text:
Priya (dev): trying the CLI quickstart with a freshly minted service token in a new SSO org. First call gets 403 billing_required. The console billing page loads but all buttons are greyed out and shows message: 'You need billing_admin role to add payment method'. I'm the org admin according to SSO though. Anyone hit this role gating?
Zoe (devex): hmm that sounds like RBAC mismatch between SSO roles and our internal roles. Can you paste the CLI command and the error blob?
Priya (dev): command:
```bash
redwood quickstart --auth sk-temp-abc --org 554433 --model rw-mini-1
```
response body:
```json
{"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"Workspace 554433 requires a billing admin to add payment method. Contact your org owner."}}
```
Priya (dev): in console IAM, my user is listed as Owner (from SSO). But the billing page shows my name and email but UI treats me as non-billing-admin.
Eli (support): possible cause: SSO group mapping didn't map the Owner group to internal billing_admin entitlement. SCIM sometimes only sets `org_role=owner` but we require the `billing_admin` entitlement to show add-card. Can you confirm the SSO assertion payload includes groups?
Priya (dev): infra-provisioning did a SCIM push. I don't have the raw assertion. Admin says they only push basic role field.
Zoe (devex): workaround: support/admins can elevate a user to billing_admin via support console (internal route) or run the admin API: `POST /internal/orgs/554433/members/assign?role=billing_admin` (internal only).
Priya (dev): i tried the support flow; support elevated me and then billing UI allowed adding card. After adding card the CLI quickstart returned 200.
auth-bot: Created audit log entry for role_change by support_user alice@redwood.example at 2912345690.
billing-bot: Found org 554433: plan=unconfigured, onboard_state=needs_billing, payment_method=null, billing_admin=null.
Zoe (devex): action items: 1) Add quickstart troubleshooting note for CLI: if you get 403 billing_required and the billing page claims you need billing_admin, ask infra to include billing_admin entitlement in SCIM mapping or ask support to elevate temporarily. 2) Add a small FAQ entry explaining which SSO attributes map to billing_admin. 3) Work with infra to include `entitlements: [billing_admin]` when provisioning interactive orgs.
Eli (support): filing ticket SUP-7261 to track adding a self-serve fallback for org owners who lack billing_admin: we can surface a request-to-elevate flow in console.
Zoe (devex): i'll update the CLI quickstart README and put a one-liner in the onboarding checklist. Also adding an analytics event to catch 403::needs_billing_admin so we can measure frequency.
Priya (dev): thanks all, workaround worked. Please ping when the README PR is live so i can update our internal docs. Closing from my side. :rocket:
